run_materialize_split_copy: run the materialize_split script in copy mode to move LibriLight data files to organized speaker directories
run_materialize_split_print: run the materialize_split script in print mode to preview file copy paths without moving data
run_materialize_split_minus: run the materialize_split script with minus flags to exclude files listed in other JSON split files
review_apply_function: review the _apply function that reads speaker metadata from JSON and copies JSON and FLAC files to destination
refactor_get_args: refactor the get_args function to add new CLI arguments for the materialize split script
